start: Member phone with 'Messages from my gym' on; a pause request is pending

user_sees: A pop-up: 'Approved: your plan is paused from 5 Nov to 12 Nov.'
must_not: A money amount or another member's data in the line
The pop-up twice

user_sees: The app opens on the plan request page (/shop)
must_not: The app opening somewhere unrelated

start: Member phone, a shop order placed

steps.action: The gym marks the order ready
user_sees: 'Your order 12 is ready. Collect it at the desk.'; a tap opens /shop/orders
must_not: A pop-up when the member cancels their own order

user_sees: 'Your gym cancelled your order 12. Ask at the desk to know why.'
must_not: No word to the member

start: Member phone, the gym asks for this member's workout report

steps.action: The gym sends a report request for the member's list entry
user_sees: 'Your gym asked to see your workout report. Open the app to say yes or no.'
must_not: The pop-up on a phone whose number is shared by two list members
The pop-up on a member with another first name

start: Member phone with 'Messages from my gym' off, or a member who left

steps.action: The gym declines a renewal request
user_sees: No pop-up; the app shows the answer when opened
must_not: A pop-up sent while the switch is off
The gym's decline blocked by a pop-up error

start: Member phone, a note waiting while the phone is off

steps.action: The phone is unreachable for 7 hours after the gym approves
user_sees: No late pop-up; the answer is in the app
must_not: A pop-up about something 7 hours old

steps.action: The same order is marked ready, then not ready, then ready again
user_sees: One pop-up only
must_not: Two pop-ups for one order

start: Member phone lock screen

user_sees: The gym's name and a short line with no amounts
must_not: Money, another member's name, or report contents on the lock screen

start: Every minute: the HQ Worker (deploy/hq/push.js) with the HQ key

user_sees: Waiting notes with the member's push addresses, each already marked done
must_not: A note handed out twice
More than the address limit, except one first note

user_sees: One pop-up per address
must_not: A note retried after the sender died (it is lost by design; the app still shows the answer)

start: Bad caller or bad notes

steps.action: Call hq_push_direct_next without the HQ key
user_sees: Refused
must_not: Any note or push address returned

steps.action: A note over 6 hours old, or for a member with no push address
user_sees: Closed as 'late' or 'no-phone', no pop-up
must_not: A stale pop-up sent

start: A trigger fires inside the gym's own save

steps.action: The note insert fails (for example a bad route)
user_sees: The gym's approval, report request or order change still saves; only a warning is logged
must_not: The gym's action rolled back by the pop-up

steps.action: 30 days after a note is done
user_sees: Deleted on a later run
must_not: Done notes kept forever

start: Report request matching

steps.action: A report request names a list entry whose number two list members share
user_sees: No note for anyone
must_not: The pop-up reaching the wrong person
